Name: Jehoahaz, King of Israel
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, reigned seventeen years, did evil, and was so oppressed by Syria that his army was left like dust to be threshed, until he besought the LORD and God gave Israel a saviour.
KeyStory: Jehoahaz oppressed by Syria prays, and God answers.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Hazael, King of Syria; Ben-Hadad III, King of Syria; Jehoash, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Even a king who did evil found that prayer still reached God.
